title: Create Task with Valid Inputs
description: Verify that a user can successfully create a task when providing all required fields with valid data.

steps.description: Navigate to the task creation form
Enter a valid task title within character limits
Provide optional description, due date/time, priority, category, and status
Submit the form to create the task
Confirm that the task is created and visible in the selected default task view
Verify that a success notification is displayed

title: Create Task with Missing Required Fields
description: Validate that the task creation form enforces required fields and shows appropriate validation errors when missing.

steps.description: Navigate to task creation form
Attempt to submit form without entering the required task title
Verify that form validation prevents submission
Check that relevant error message(s) are displayed near the required input fields

title: Update Existing Task Successfully
description: Verify that modifying an existing task's details saves changes and correctly updates the UI and calendar sync.

steps.description: Select an existing task from any view
Modify task details including title, due date/time, priority, and status
Save the updated task
Check that the UI reflects the updated task information
Verify local task data is updated and triggers bi-directional sync with Google Calendar

title: Delete Task with Confirmation and Sync
description: Ensure deleting a task prompts confirmation and deletes the task locally and from Google Calendar with notifications.

steps.description: Select a task for deletion
Initiate the delete action
Verify a confirmation dialog appears asking for user confirmation
Confirm deletion
Check that the task is removed from the UI
Validate the linked Google Calendar event is deleted accordingly
Observe success notification confirming deletion

title: Two-Way Synchronization Real-Time Update
description: Validate that when a task is updated in the app, the changes are immediately reflected in Google Calendar and vice versa.

steps.description: Create or update a task in the app with a due date/time matching a Google Calendar event
Confirm the corresponding Google Calendar event is created or updated shortly after
Update the event details using Google Calendar directly
Check that the app reflects the updated task details in near real-time

title: Synchronization Conflict Resolution Handling
description: Test the application's ability to detect and resolve conflicts arising from simultaneous task edits locally and in Google Calendar.

steps.description: Simultaneously edit the same task locally in the app and in Google Calendar with conflicting changes
Verify that the app detects the conflict during sync
Check that user is prompted with conflict resolution options or that an automated resolution strategy is applied
Confirm that the final resolved version is consistent and synchronized both locally and in Google Calendar

title: Task Views Rendering and Switching
description: Ensure that task views (list, grid, calendar, Kanban) render correctly and switching between them updates the UI accurately.

steps.description: Navigate to the dashboard
Switch to list view and verify tasks are displayed correctly
Switch to grid view and verify tasks layout and information are correct
Switch to calendar view and confirm tasks appear on correct dates and support drag-and-drop rescheduling
Switch to Kanban board and verify tasks are organized correctly by status or category
Check UI responsiveness and smooth transition between views

title: Drag-and-Drop Rescheduling in Calendar View
description: Verify that tasks/events can be rescheduled by dragging and dropping within calendar views and that changes persist and sync correctly.

steps.description: Open calendar view with existing tasks/events displayed
Drag a task/event from one date/time slot to another
Confirm UI updates task's scheduled date/time accordingly
Verify updated schedule is synced to Google Calendar in near real-time
Check for any error messages or conflicts after rescheduling

title: Filtering, Sorting, and Searching Tasks
description: Validate the ability to filter tasks by status, priority, category; sort tasks by due date; and search tasks by keywords.

steps.description: Navigate to task list or board view
Apply multiple filters including status and category simultaneously
Ensure only matching tasks are displayed
Sort tasks by due date ascending and descending
Verify tasks order respects sorting selection
Use search input to find tasks via partial and full keyword matches
Confirm search results are accurate and update in real-time

title: Offline Mode Task Operations with Sync Recovery
description: Test task creation, updates, and deletions performed offline queue correctly and sync automatically upon reconnection without data loss.

steps.description: Disable network connection or simulate offline mode
Create, update, and delete multiple tasks locally
Validate that local changes show appropriate offline status or indicators
Reconnect network
Confirm queued operations sync successfully with Google Calendar and backend
Check no data loss or synchronization errors occur

title: OAuth 2.0 Token Secure Management
description: Verify that Google OAuth authentication tokens are obtained, stored securely, refreshed on expiration, and revoked appropriately when disconnecting.

steps.description: Initiate Google OAuth 2.0 authentication flow
Confirm successful authentication and retrieval of access and refresh tokens
Validate tokens are stored encrypted locally
Simulate token expiration and trigger token refresh
Verify tokens refresh seamlessly without user interruption
Disconnect Google Calendar account
Check tokens are securely removed or revoked

title: Connection Status Indicator Accuracy
description: Ensure the Google Calendar connection status indicators correctly reflect connection, syncing, error, and offline statuses in the UI.

steps.description: Connect and authenticate Google Calendar account
Verify the indicator shows active connection and syncing status
Simulate syncing error or loss of connection
Confirm indicator updates to error or disconnected state
Switch to offline mode
Validate indicator reflects offline queueing state

title: Notification Settings and Triggering
description: Confirm that notification settings changes persist and that notifications trigger correctly based on user preferences and task events.

steps.description: Navigate to settings panel and open notification preferences
Modify notification preferences (enable/disable, set reminder times)
Save preferences
Verify settings persist after page reload or relogin
Create or update tasks with reminders set according to user preferences
Confirm that notifications trigger at expected times

title: User Interface Responsiveness and Accessibility
description: Check UI elements adapt responsively across various device screen sizes and support keyboard navigation and accessibility standards.

steps.description: Open the application on desktop, tablet, and mobile screen sizes
Verify UI elements resize, reorganize and remain usable without overlapping or truncation
Navigate the application using keyboard only (tab, enter, arrows)
Confirm focus indicators are visible and all interactive elements are reachable
Check color contrast and labeling for screen readers and accessibility tools

title: Security: Input Sanitization to Prevent XSS and CSRF
description: Test that all user input fields sanitize inputs correctly to prevent cross-site scripting and implement protections against cross-site request forgery.

steps.description: Attempt to input scripts or malicious code in task title, description, and other fields
Verify input is sanitized and scripts do not execute
Verify CSRF tokens are present and validated in task create, update, and delete requests
Ensure unauthorized requests are rejected based on missing or invalid CSRF tokens

title: Performance with Large Number of Tasks
description: Evaluate application performance and UI responsiveness when rendering and interacting with 100+ tasks in various views.

steps.description: Populate the application with 100+ tasks across multiple categories and statuses
Navigate between different task views: list, grid, calendar, Kanban
Perform filtering, sorting, and searching operations
Measure and confirm page load time is under 3 seconds
Verify task rendering is smooth with no lag or UI freezes
Check search and sync operations respond within acceptable time frames

title: Settings Panel Persistence and Functionality
description: Verify changes in user settings (UI preferences, calendar sync options, privacy controls) persist across sessions and apply correctly.

steps.description: Open settings panel and modify UI preference options (e.g., theme, layout)
Change calendar synchronization options and privacy controls
Save settings and refresh the application
Confirm all changes persist after refresh or logout/login
Verify UI and synchronization behaviors reflect updated settings
